race.comment: FLYING BRANT (4) showed nice improvement last time out when second-up from a spell, leading into the lane before the condition gave out at the end of 1556m. Perfectly placed out to 1800m at this stage of the campaign. SUPER LAD (2) has been mediocre in three runs this prep but all have been over sprint courses. Runner-up in this race last year and will be ready to peak for it again. CRADLE OF JAZZ (3) missed the frame for the first time in a while last start over 1956m at the Parks circuit. Honest mare who is in the right race to bounce back to form. LONGER ROUTE (8) just missed two back over this distance in town carrying 60kgs. Must be considered.
